scenes.text: “Finds the cheapest supplier.” Based on what? Quality? Lead time? Contract terms? Who approved the supplier list?
Then “places an order automatically.” With what spending limit? Who signed off?
Nobody gave me a budget, a rule or a supplier, and I’m supposed to have spent €3,000 on poultry? I’d like to see the approval trail. Oh wait. There isn’t one. Because I didn’t do it.
